title: observability: token-level cost/latency + tracing + dashboard alert tuning
author: Liam Chen
release_notes: Added token-level cost and latency panels to Grafana, improved tracing spans for request->model hops, tuned high-cardinality alerts to reduce noise; no behavior changes to inference paths.
description: Motivation: Teams need finer-grained observability to correlate cost and latency at the token level with KV cache behavior and tracing spans. This PR adds token-level cost and latency metrics to Prometheus, enriches tracing spans with model and routing metadata, updates Grafana dashboards with new panels, and tunes alert thresholds to reduce noisy paging. Checklist: 1) Add token-level metrics (promql + exporter) 2) Add tracing tags to runtime spans 3) Dashboard updates + panel layouts 4) Alert tuning + runbook links 5) Tests and CI. Commits summary: a) exporter: emit redwood_token_latency_seconds_bucket, redwood_token_cost_total, redwood_kv_cache_hit_count and labels (model, route, quantization_profile) b) tracing: add span tags span.set_tag('model.variant', ...) and include request.route_id and token_count in root span c) grafana: new dashboard json panels for per-route cost-per-token, p50/p95 token-latency histograms, kv cache hit-rate heatmap d) alerts: update alert rules to use increased burn-rate windows and aggregate by route to avoid noisy alerts for low-traffic routes e) docs: update observability.md and alert runbook. Files changed (high level): metrics/exporter/controller.go (instrumentation + new metrics), runtime/trace/span_instrumentation.go (add tags), grafana/dashboards/observability-token-level.json (new panels), prometheus/rules/token_alerts.yml (tuned rules), docs/observability.md (docs), tests/exporter_test.go (unit tests), e2e/observability_smoke_test.go (integration). Review conversation highlights: Reviewer Ava: "Nice, the per-route aggregation should reduce pager noise; please verify cardinality for model labels." Author replied: "Added label cardinality guard by truncating long model names and adding quantization_profile as an opt-in label via config; updated exporter's README." Reviewer Miguel: "Can we sample logs on high-traffic routes to avoid log explosion?" Author: "Added sampling logic behind feature flag and defaulted to 1% for routes with >1000 req/min; documented in observability.md." Reviewer Sofia: "Alert thresholds look sensible, but please add a test that simulates a cache-regression spike to ensure alerts fire." Author: "Added e2e test that toggles cache hit-rate; CI passes on my branch." CI details: build: pass, unit tests: pass (coverage +0.2%), integration e2e: pass, lint: pass, grafana-schema-validate: pass. Manual QA: Verified dashboards in staging with synthetic traffic and confirmed alerts only triggered for aggregate routes with sustained degradation. Merge notes: approved by reviewers after two iterations; squash-merged to main. Rollout plan: dashboards enabled in staging immediately, rollout to prod during maintenance window next week; monitoring team to watch alert noise for 48h. Related: ENG-2045 implements follow-up to expose model family as low-cardinality label. Misc: No behavioral changes to inference core; metrics only.
notes: This PR focuses on observability instrumentation and alert tuning. Metric names were chosen to be consistent with existing redwood_* prefix. Added configuration knobs for label cardinality and log sampling to avoid high cardinality in Prometheus and storage costs. Follow-up work tracked in ENG-2045 to expose low-cardinality model_family label.
